subject: Welcome to BranchChat! Here's what's new
headline: Welcome! Here’s what’s new
paragraphs: Welcome to BranchChat! We're so glad you're here. BranchChat is a private, friendly place to chat, share photos and keep up with the people you care about.

Meet your new friend, the BranchChat Helper bot. You'll find it in your chat list. It's there to show you around: say hi to it, and it will walk you through adding friends, starting a group, reacting to messages and setting up your picture.

What's new lately: a sound settings panel with six button sounds and separate volume sliders, a Frequently used row and tabs in the emoji picker, a GIF button, and a cleaner, easier-to-read look across the app.
Thanks for joining us. We hope BranchChat feels like a cozy spot by the fire for you and your family.
